sources.title: ParaTrace AI text detector · Was this text written by AI?
sources.snippet: ParaTrace estimates how likely it is that an English text was produced by a language model, and gives every document a probability and a clear verdict. In our latest benchmark it caught 99.6 % of AI-written answers from 89 models, while wrongly flagging fewer than 1 in 100 held-out human texts.
